body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-23 10:06Z; my own idle slip on w-748c). After a focused GREEN run, I ended the turn to let the run settle and planned "the review pair next turn". But no wake arrived, so I idled for about 30 min until Fable2's status check (#360). Fix: when I end a turn only to let a run settle, the next turn is triggered only by mail. So either (a) start the review pair in the SAME turn right after the run ends, since spawning read-only reviewers is not a worktree command or edit and cannot touch the run's credit; or (b) if I must wait, tell the coordinator explicitly that I am waiting for a wake. Default: (a).
